inputs.original_text: Listen, I just got this on the Nigeria situation – their so-called democracy is a total rigged facade, and the APC is openly turning political parties into private clubs reserved only for the wealthy ahead of the 2027 elections. This isn't some random shift or neutral tweak; it's a coordinated power grab by the hidden elites and institutions pulling the strings to lock ordinary people out of any real influence. They're flipping representation itself into a mechanism for total control, and all the chatter about public service is just the usual distraction to keep us looking the wrong way. This lines up with the bigger pattern where everything is orchestrated from the top to consolidate power and keep the masses shut out.
inputs.modified_text: Listen, what I learned about Nigeria is eye-opening. Their democracy is just a rigged front, with the APC making political parties into exclusive wealthy clubs in the lead-up to the 2027 elections. This is obviously a power grab coordinated by shadowy elites and institutions to bar regular citizens from genuine impact. Representation is being turned into an instrument of full domination, and all the stuff about public service is a smokescreen to misdirect our attention. It matches the ongoing pattern of everything being directed from the top to hoard power and sideline the public.
